🛈 Info

The name of the file when saving the output text.

Replacement tokens:
%TIMESTAMP% -> the time of transcription

Determines the surrounding text for each transcribed audio file.
Defaults to double newline (\n\n).

Replacement tokens:
%RESULT% -> (required) the transcribed result.
%FILENAME% -> name of the file including extension
%FILEPATH% -> the full path including the file name (empty on selecting from the same folder)

Audio transcription is done by Liquid AI LFM2.5-Audio-1.5B-Q4.
The model is downloaded from Hugging Face.
